scope: All 30 paired existing TRAIN examples; closed-set author identification, not frozen test evaluation
split_strategy: Paired StratifiedKFold, shuffle=True; no Original/Rewrite pair crosses folds
primary: Matched representation: fit Original/train -> Original/dev; independently fit Rewrite/train -> Rewrite/dev with identical pipeline, hyperparameters and fold IDs
secondary: Same fitted Original pipeline -> paired Rewrite/dev; diagnostic for transfer/distribution shift
features: existing 66 raw stylometric features, including function-word rates; no topic/content embeddings
scaling: StandardScaler fit on training fold separately inside each pipeline; never full-data or held-out scaling
acceptance_rule: not applied; future human meaning=Yes AND human stance=Yes AND human style=Yes applied to every row
